site.tagline: Tactile games & playful apps, built to own.
site.heroDescription: Independent developer crafting expressive, touch-first games and interactive toys for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS — with Android releases on the way.
site.androidStatusBanner: Android versions are currently in development. More games and interactive apps coming soon.

pillars.title: Pay Once, Own Forever
pillars.description: Every release is a straightforward $0.99 one-time purchase. No subscriptions, no paywalls, and no in-app purchases.

pillars.title: Zero Ads, Zero Tracking
pillars.description: No accounts required, no ad networks, and no personal data collected. Your apps stay cleanly on your device.

pillars.title: Built for Touch & Play
pillars.description: Designed around tactile multitouch, responsive haptics, atmospheric sound, and offline play anywhere.

apps.title: Rock, Paper, Carnage
apps.subtitle: Rock, paper, scissors with finishing moves.
apps.pricingNote: One-time purchase · iOS & iPadOS · No ads · No IAP

trailer.title: Official Launch Trailer
trailer.caption: Spot the tell, nail the combo, and unleash the finishing move.

apps.shortDescription: You're a contestant on the galaxy's most violent game show, and the only thing you brought is your hand. Spot tells, nail combo finishers, and survive eight wild arenas.
apps.leadParagraph: You were on your couch. Now you're a contestant on the galaxy's most violent game show, and the only thing you brought is your hand.
bodyParagraphs: Rock, Paper, Carnage is rock, paper, scissors with finishing moves. Win the throw, punch in the combo before the clock runs out, and your hand turns into a boulder, a buzzsaw, a storm of paper cuts, and more. Miss it and the crowd boos. Lose the round and your opponent finishes you.

features.title: Read Your Opponent
features.description: Every opponent has a tell — and most of the time it tells the truth. Spot it, throw what beats it, and earn that level's signature finisher.

features.title: Rhythm Showdowns
features.description: Throw the same sign and your hands lock into a rhythm duel set to an original song. Win a showdown for a star; two stars unlock your Ultimate.

features.title: Eight Opponents, Eight Arenas
features.description: Face a baby monkey under the circus big top, a toddler at daycare, an orangutan in the rainforest canopy, a coworker in the office break room, a bodybuilder at the beach gym, a silverback in the aquarium hall, the Galactic Warlord, and the Kraken.

features.title: Unlock More Carnage
features.description: Earn points on the reward track to unlock finishers like the Wrecking Ball, the Guillotine, and the Meteor — plus blood styles from slime to confetti. Beat a boss to unlock Hard Mode.

highlights: $0.99 one-time purchase — no ads, no in-app purchases
Built for touch with haptics on every press

faq.a: All game progress is saved locally on your device. Deleting the app removes your saved progress.

faq.q: Does the game require an internet connection?
faq.a: No. Rock, Paper, Carnage plays completely offline.

faq.q: Are there ads or in-app purchases?
faq.a: No. It is a single $0.99 one-time purchase with zero ads and zero in-app purchases.

faq.q: Why does iOS mention the camera or microphone in diagnostics?
faq.a: That reference comes from code bundled inside the game engine's video player. Rock, Paper, Carnage never accesses your camera or microphone.

apps.privacySummary: Rock, Paper, Carnage collects no personal data, requires no account, and contains no third-party ad or analytics trackers.

apps.title: Plasma Globe: Fidget Lamp
apps.subtitle: A classic plasma ball under your fingers.
apps.pricingNote: One purchase covers iOS, iPadOS & macOS · No ads · No IAP
apps.shortDescription: Touch the glass and lightning leaps from the coil to meet you — one bolt for every finger, complete with haptics, parallax tilt, ten lightning hues, and desk lamp mode.
apps.leadParagraph: Plasma Globe puts a classic plasma ball under your fingers. Touch the glass and lightning leaps from the coil to meet you, one bolt for every finger.
bodyParagraphs: Built to feel alive on a desk or in your hands, Plasma Globe pairs real multitouch lightning with responsive haptics, subtle tilt parallax, and rich night-room ambience. Leave it untouched and it settles into a calm, glowing desk lamp.

features.title: Real Multitouch Lightning
features.description: Every finger draws its own crackling filament — up to five simultaneous bolts on iPhone and even more on iPad.

features.title: Tactile Haptics & Sound
features.description: Feel a low electric hum and sharp snaps on iPhone as arcs jump to your fingertips, paired with reactive crackle and night-time ambience of crickets, crows, and the occasional cat.

features.title: Ten Colors & Spectrum Tube
features.description: Pick from ten vivid lightning presets or sweep continuously across the spectrum tube to tune any wavelength.

features.title: Atmosphere & Desk Lamp Mode
features.description: Tilt your device to peer around the glass sphere amid drifting fog, a swinging lamp, and moving shadows. The screen stays awake, settling into a calm glow when left untouched.

highlights: One $0.99 purchase covers iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
No accounts, no ads, and no data collected
Screen-awake desk lamp mode for ambient lighting

screenshots.caption: Classic Violet — multitouch lightning arcs leaping to the glass

screenshots.caption: Spectrum Selector — ten presets plus continuous wavelength tuning

notices.title: Tip for iPad Users
notices.text: Four- and five-finger swipes belong to iPadOS system gestures. To rest your whole hand flat on the glass, disable them in Settings → Multitasking & Gestures.

notices.title: Visual Sensitivity Note
notices.text: Contains flickering and flashing light effects.

faq.q: Does one purchase work across all my Apple devices?
faq.a: Yes — a single $0.99 purchase unlocks Plasma Globe across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

faq.q: Can I leave it running as a desk lamp?
faq.a: Yes. Plasma Globe keeps your screen awake and automatically settles into a calmer ambient glow whenever it's left untouched.

faq.q: Does it require an account or internet connection?
faq.a: No accounts, no internet required, no ads, and zero data collection.

apps.privacySummary: Plasma Globe: Fidget Lamp requires no account, shows no ads, and collects zero personal data.

apps.title: School Time!
apps.subtitle: A living reef aquarium you can touch — and a timer you can watch.
apps.pricingNote: One-time purchase · iPad & macOS · No ads · No tracking
apps.shortDescription: Lead 1,600 golden fish across a vibrant coral reef with your fingertips — then set a timer and release a pack of barracuda to hunt the school down to the final second.
apps.leadParagraph: School Time is a living reef aquarium you can touch, and a timer you can watch.
bodyParagraphs: Sixteen hundred golden fish swim as one across a sunlit coral reef. Lead them with a finger, split the school with two hands, or let them roam freely on a second screen. When it's time to focus, set any timer from 30 seconds to 2 hours and press HUNT — a pack of barracuda drops in and catches the fish at the exact pace of your countdown.

features.title: Lead 1,600 Golden Fish
features.description: Touch the glass and the entire school follows your finger. Spread two fingers to split the school in two, bring them together to merge, or tap to startle them.

features.title: The Barracuda Countdown
features.description: Set any timer from 0:30 to 2:00:00 and press HUNT. One glance tells you how much time remains: it's the size of the school. When the last fish disappears in a puff of bubbles, a buoy bell rings.

features.title: Four Living Reef Views
features.description: Explore corals, sea fans, sponges, clownfish, tangs, parrotfish, and nautiluses from four camera perspectives — in the tank, gallery window, down the reef, or swimming with the school — each with pan and zoom.

features.title: Built for Focus & Everyday Timers
features.description: Keeps ticking in the background with optional finish notifications, subtle sonar pings, pause/resume controls, and an automatic power saver for long sessions.

highlights: Timers from 30 seconds to 2 hours with exact custom entry
No blood or gore — caught fish vanish in a puff of bubbles
Works offline with no accounts, no ads, and no tracking
Great for focus sessions, study breaks, board games, or tea

faq.q: Does the timer keep running if I lock my screen or switch apps?
faq.a: Yes. The timer stays accurate in the background and sends a notification when time is up if notifications are allowed.
Yes — rated 4+ with no blood or gore. When a barracuda catches a fish, it disappears in a puff of bubbles.

faq.q: Can I just watch the aquarium without setting a timer?
faq.a: Absolutely. Lift your hand and the school roams naturally across the reef, making it great to leave running on an iPad or second screen.

apps.privacySummary: School Time! works completely offline, requires no account, displays no ads, and collects no personal data or tracking.
